name: Thick Skin
desc: +3 max HP.

name: Shake It Off
desc: Standing up from Prone costs no action, once per round.

name: Iron Jaw
desc: A head hit leaves you Stunned, never Incapacitated, while you are above 0 HP.

name: Bone Setter
desc: First aid on a broken arm or crippled leg needs no roll, and you can treat yourself.

name: Unbreakable
desc: Once per combat, refuse a condition as it is applied.

name: Second Wind
desc: Once per combat, 1 action: heal 2d6 HP.

name: Street Smarts
desc: +1 Streetwise / Dealing and +1 Deception / Conning.

name: Fixer's Number
desc: Street prices (cash) are 10% cheaper.

name: Read the Room
desc: +2 TN on Persuasion or Deception against someone you've watched act this scene.

name: Clean Slate
desc: Once: +5 Credit Score, and one criminal record is quietly cleared.

name: Network
desc: Once per mission, a contact gives you intel, a door, or a favor (the GM decides).

name: Safe House
desc: In downtime, injuries are treated and armor is repaired for free.

name: Quick Draw
desc: +2 initiative.

name: Cover Habit
desc: Partial cover gives you +3 instead of +2.

name: Marksman
desc: Location attacks at −2 TN instead of −4.

name: Fast Hands
desc: Once per round, reloading or swapping weapons costs no action.

name: Killzone
desc: When you Aim, the attack also gets +2 TN.

name: Bodyguard
desc: Once per round, take a hit meant for an adjacent ally.

name: Drilled
desc: Start every combat with +1 TP.

name: Hardened
desc: +1 armor in Defensive stance.

name: Thick Plates
desc: +1 armor in Onslaught (it softens the ×1.5 damage you take).

name: Momentum
desc: Dropping an enemy gives +1 TP.

name: Unstoppable
desc: In Onslaught you can't be knocked Prone.

name: Command Voice
desc: Commanding Directive costs 1 TP less.

name: Spotter's Eye
desc: Coordinated Crossfire lasts until the end of the next round.

name: Battle Plan
desc: Once per round, the ally who acts right after you gets +2 TN on one attack.

name: Heat Sink
desc: The deck vents 2 heat per round instead of 1.

name: Cold Boot
desc: After a Blue Screen the deck reboots at cap − 5 instead of − 3.

name: Silver Tongue
desc: Credentials Spoof costs 1 RAM less.

name: Social Engineer
desc: +2 TN on Deception against cybernetic targets.

name: Ghost
desc: Your sustained hacks survive a Blue Screen (normally it crashes them all).

name: Overclocker
desc: +1 RAM.

name: Thermal Discipline
desc: Overclock Pulse makes 2 less heat.

name: Chain Reaction
desc: Feedback Loop jumps to an adjacent cybernetic or synthetic target for half damage.

name: Quick Tune
desc: Every combat starts at Warm instead of Cold.

name: Grounded
desc: Disruption only when you lose 4 or more HP in one hit.

name: Field Medic
desc: Mend healing +1.

name: Reinforce
desc: Field Maintenance mends 3 cracks instead of 2.

name: Steady Rig
desc: Switching mode keeps 1 Sync.

name: Live Wire
desc: Surge damage +1.

name: Extra Mount
desc: Your sentry turret has +1 armor and +4 HP.

name: Overload
desc: A Resonant cast doesn't drop Sync below Warm.

name: Poker Face
desc: Once per combat, move the pendulum 1 toward 0 for free.

name: Deep Pockets
desc: Contraband Stash also works at 0 (Composure).

name: Hair Trigger
desc: When Hot: +2 damage instead of +1.

name: Lucky Mag
desc: Desperate Gamble needs only 2 rounds loaded.

name: Showstopper
desc: Once per combat, a Hot attack that hits also knocks the target Prone.

name: Old Friends
desc: Call in Favor needs only ≤ −2.

name: Ghost Routes
desc: Safehouse Route moves two allies.

name: Kingpin
desc: Call in Favor twice per combat.

name: Cold Read
desc: The first time you place Tells in a combat, place 1 extra.

name: Scrounger
desc: Salvage takes 2 items instead of 1.

name: Sticky Fingers
desc: Once per combat, Lift costs no Tells (it still needs the roll).

name: Dirty Fighting
desc: Exploit rolls d6 instead of d4 with a melee weapon.

name: Clean Sweep
desc: Strip both disarms the target and cracks its armor by 2.

name: Shared Notes
desc: Mark also gives allies +1d4 damage against the target.

name: Patient Eye
desc: From full cover, Case the Room places 2 Tells on one of its targets.

name: Long Memory
desc: When a target holding your Tells goes down, move up to 2 of them to another enemy you can see.
